text: The Patriots delivered a commanding 45-17 dismantling of the Raiders at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, with Drake Maye accounting for five total touchdowns despite missing his top receiver and operating without both starting cornerbacks in the secondary—a performance that suggests he's found his confidence and his deep ball after a shaky start to the season. The victory came at a cost, however, as running back TreVeyon Henderson suffered an ankle injury and left tackle Will Campbell departed with a knee sprain believed to be a sprain, adding to New England's mounting injury concerns even as the team proved it can dominate on the field when healthy enough to take the field.
